## Context orchestration and management — 2026-10-13, record 93

[Record 93](93_CONTEXT_ORCHESTRATION.md) reserves the actual reply ceiling, rejects impossible fixed requests before auxiliary work, preserves the full active request and complete tool exchanges, and fences cancelled/superseded summary and recall results. Mutable token caches stay accurate; evidence residency requires shown text. Summary input is serialized once with exact bounds and independent head/tail admission. Local fixtures and source faults qualify these mechanisms; context benchmark version 4 strengthens output accounting. Model-summary quality, installed long-task latency/RSS/energy, complete crash/resume journeys and release remain Target. CU/UI implementation is untouched.

## Context boundary qualification — 2026-10-13

[Record 93](../../93_CONTEXT_ORCHESTRATION.md) requires real prompt text before reporting an evidence span as resident: an archive handle or a matching file path alone is insufficient, and a derived block cannot make an absent dependency resident. Stale spans remain excluded. Code-search import relationships show both endpoints even when ranking returns the importer first. Run the new context orchestration suite, `npm run test:context`, benchmark version 4 and the source-fault runner. These offline end states do not qualify live semantic quality, installed journeys or model answers.

## Context cancellation and continuation qualification — 2026-10-13

[Record 93](../../93_CONTEXT_ORCHESTRATION.md) adds offline recovery obligations: Stop during recall/summarization ends without a main request; late/superseded compaction cannot publish continuation or evidence; failed/truncated summary attempts never become a successful narrative; the full active request and valid complete tool exchanges survive trimming. Bounded, hash-checked archives keep failed-summary conversation evidence when storage admits it. Run `src/__tests__/context.orchestration.sprint.test.ts` and `scripts/prove-context-orchestration.py`. This is a cancellation/compaction slice, not installed process-crash replay or complete R01 qualification.
